text:
viv: Heads-up — onboarding quickstart broke for a user when using jsonMode + function-calls. Tool param is an array of numeric ids (number[]), but the Node SDK is sending the args with the ids as strings. Schema validator fails: expected number, got string.

hana: Oh no. Do you have the repro & schema? Which SDK version?

viv: Repro: clone sample-kit/id-extractor, run `yarn start --jsonMode` then POST a payload that triggers the tool `fetch_items`. Tool schema: 
```json
{
  "name": "fetch_items",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "array",
    "items": { "type": "number" }
  }
}
```
Observed payload printed by the Node quickstart: `function_call: { name: 'fetch_items', arguments: ["123", "456"] }` whereas validator expects [123, 456]. Error: `Type mismatch at /parameters: expected number but got string`. Python SDK emits numbers correctly.

kevin: Hmm. We added a stringify step in the JSON-mode serializer to avoid issues with BigInt and with some header-escaping edgecases. Looks like we over-aggressively stringify arrays of primitives. That was meant to be conservative but breaks strict-number schemas.

eileen: Quick workaround for onboarding: sample-kit can coerce numeric strings -> numbers on the handler: `args = args.map(v => typeof v === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(v) ? Number(v) : v)`. Not great but unblocks signups.

hana: We should be careful — coercing silently could hide real type problems. Better to add an explicit fallback that only runs in the quickstarts and logs a warning. Also add a short note in the onboarding doc about this pitfall.

kevin: Plan: revert the stringify in the serializer for arrays of primitives; only preserve stringify for BigInt or non-JSON-safe values. Add unit tests covering arrays of numbers, booleans, and mixed primitive arrays. Also add a parity test against Py SDK to ensure numeric types are preserved.

sdk-bot: Issue created: DEVEX-1005 "node-sdk jsonMode: primitive-array serializer stringifies numbers breaking strict schemas" (assigned to @kevin).

qa-bot: Suggest adding an e2e in sample-kit: run quickstart with JSON_MODE and assert handler receives numbers for `number[]` schemas, and add a failing-case test that would catch future regressions.

eileen: I'll open a tiny PR to add the coercion shim in the sample quickstart and a log line pointing to DEVEX-1005. Keep it opt-in behind an env var so we don't mask prod issues.

viv: Thanks — blocking onboarding until the SDK patch lands + sample-kit test. If anyone wants to pair on the unit tests/fixture I can help this afternoon.

hana: Also let's add a CLI lint that warns when a tool schema declares `number` but the sample handler returns strings in existing quickstarts. That will save new contributors a lot of confusion.

kevin: Will push a PR tonight with serializer change + tests and a changelog note.

viv: Great, marking DEVEX-1005 as high priority for onboarding flows.
